help.stdout:
usage: gnd compose [-h] --out OUT --record RECORD model directory

Read DIR/manifest.json and, for each source id it lists,
DIR/<id>/population.json, its adjacent anchor sidecar and
DIR/<id>/document.txt. Bind every sidecar, apply the manifest's renamings,
collapse identical rows, and write the composed population and a value-free
composition record. Nothing is merged that the manifest does not list. Check
the result with gnd check --composition RECORD --sources DIR.

positional arguments:
  model            path to the model file
  directory        composition directory

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --out OUT        path of the composed population to write
  --record RECORD  path of the composition record to write

unknown_flag.stderr:
usage: gnd compose [-h] --out OUT --record RECORD model directory
gnd compose: error: the following arguments are required: model, directory, --out, --record
